card.name: Where artworks or signs are displayed
card.fires_on: Words just before a place where an object is displayed, such as a bust, portrait, sign or diploma. They fall between the object and the wall, hall, pavement or altar where it sits or hangs.

modes.label: Bust or statue placement
modes.description: Verbs or adverbs after a sculpture or effigy that lead into where it stands or lies.
modes.example: whose bust<< now>> stands in the City Hall compound

modes.label: Hung on a wall
modes.description: Words that lead into a wall or surface where something is posted or hung.
modes.example: can post their high school diploma on the<< wall>> and college teachers

modes.label: Linking word before a location
modes.description: Small words like for, on or from linking an artwork or image to its site.
modes.example: executed in 1526<< for>> the altar of Or San Michele

card.writes: It pushes toward words about hanging things on walls and in corridors, such as hang, wall and hanging, mostly in Chinese and English.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say where a picture, bust or sign is mounted or displayed.
